items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went to Miller High School where Al McKibbon went, as you know... I remember once Al McKibbon coming back to visit the school and I was in a class holding a bass and Al McKibbon was there looking at me.

ctx.x: And presumably, as you said, segregated neighborhood?
Oh yeah, absolutely. The high school was Miller High School, I went to Miller High School where Al McKibbon went, as you know, and Milt Jackson, and also I went to Duffield Grade School.
So those were all within the neighborhood?
